title: 第23章 礼物第24章 急训 上
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
林江月见徐子奇一副认真笃定的表情。
难道他真的能换人？
林江月懂得知进退，挂上笑脸说道。
“我绝对是救你妹妹的不二人选，徐师叔放心，这件事包在我身上了！”
徐子奇见林江月精神恢复，便顺势接着说道。
“论心性毅力林师侄绝对是我心中的不二人选，换做他人，我也不放心。”
“这里面有清目提神丹，可短暂提高神识力量；还有护心盘，用灵气催动可抵御一次重击；还有一盏回魂灯，神识游走之前点燃，可在保神魂不散。”
林江月闻言，轻轻掂了掂手中袋子，才意识到徐子奇是有备而来。
他表面看似直愣，实则洞察人心。
说什么换个人选，不过是在试探决心。
“多谢徐师叔，我定不负所望。”
徐子奇满意一笑，又拿出一个冰晶蓝袋给她。
“我知你吃不惯辟谷丹，这个袋子乃用千年玄冰铁，揉万丝穿线制成，可保鲜食材不腐。”
“保鲜袋？”
林江月捂住嘴，目光却紧盯着徐子奇的手。
“这么说也可。”
“哇，这可太好了，那我明日可带些兽肉去赵真人那儿了，就地开火吃些热乎的。”
这个宝贝比刚才所有的东西都要好！
林江月躬身接过储物袋，高兴的原地跺脚。
徐子奇低头看着眼前的小姑娘开心模样，一脸慈爱。

“你就是个吃货！保命的东西不在意，反而对一个储物的袋子如此上心。”
林江月收起保鲜袋，想起自己还煮着饭，又是看火又是看饭。
“还好还好，没有煮糊。”
徐子奇见林江月心性至真，又叹张大虎收的好徒弟，留下一句话便心满意足的离开了。
“林师侄，赵真人阵法并不可怕，勇于直面内心，方能勘破一切虚无，临危不乱方能破阵。”
林江月挑眉翻弄蒸好的米饭，口中轻语。
“要是这么容易就好了咯！”
林江月将米饭蒸熟后，立刻把切好的兽肉丁拌入热饭中。
趁着饭肉温热的黏性，又掺进洗净的青菜碎与鲜菌菇丁，反复搅匀，捏成一个个扎实的饭团。
接着处理从溪边捕来的小鱼，去鳞除脏，拭干水分，入热油炸至酥透，再趁热浸入调好的酱汁里，做成油亮咸香的油浸小鱼。
本想再找些雏英鸡蛋摊几张蛋饼，奈何洞府附近实在寻不着。
只好取出仅剩的晒干雏英鸡肉，上锅蒸软，将蒸出的浓鲜汤汁侵入灵米饭。
再把鸡肉撕成细丝，加辛辣调料拌匀，裹在饭团表面揉搓成团。
一顿操作之后林江月累的眯眼伸懒腰。
最后她兴奋的将做好的食材装进保鲜袋。
不过当然留了五个她最想吃的鸡肉丝包饭。
外韧微辣的鸡肉搭配咸鲜的米饭，幸福感爆棚。
“此时要是有点小酒就好了！”
林江月眼珠一转，想起刘信送的那坛酒，打开盖来，小酌一杯。
“美哉美哉。”

灵酒下肚灵力爆满，灵饭下肚体力爆满。
“壮哉壮哉。”
吃完最后一个，林江月又想去拿，回见自己的小肚腩，轻轻一拍，漾起涟漪：“不能再吃了，要变成小肥猪了！”
饭后林江月收拾好灶台厨具，发现月上树梢头。
原想趁着精气神满席地打坐练功。
content_en:
Lin Jiangyue saw Xu Ziqi's serious and determined expression.
Could he really be replaced?
Lin Jiangyue knew how to advance and retreat, and said with a smile on her face.
"I am definitely the best choice to save your sister. Don't worry, Master Xu, this matter will be taken care of by me!"
Seeing that Lin Jiangyue's energy had recovered, Xu Ziqi continued speaking.
"In terms of mental perseverance, Senior Nephew Lin is definitely the best choice in my heart. If it were anyone else, I wouldn't trust him."
"There is an eye-clearing and refreshing pill inside, which can temporarily increase the power of the spiritual consciousness; there is also a heart-protecting disk, which can be activated with spiritual energy to resist a heavy blow; and there is also a soul-reviving lamp, which can be lit before the spiritual consciousness wanders, to protect the soul."
Hearing this, Lin Jiangyue lightly weighed the bag in her hand and realized that Xu Ziqi had come prepared.
On the surface, he seems to be stunned, but in fact he has insight into people's hearts.
Talking about changing someone is just testing your resolve.
"Thank you, Master Xu. I will definitely live up to your expectations."
Xu Ziqi smiled with satisfaction and took out another ice crystal blue bag for her.
"I know you are not used to Bigu Pills. This bag is made of thousand-year-old black ice iron, kneaded and threaded with thousands of threads. It can keep the food fresh and prevent it from rotting."
"Plastic bag?"
Lin Jiangyue covered her mouth, but stared at Xu Ziqi's hand.
"That's okay."
"Wow, this is great. Then I can bring some animal meat to Zhenren Zhao's place tomorrow and open fire on the spot to eat some hot food."
This baby is better than all the other ones!
Lin Jiangyue bowed and took the storage bag, stamping her feet happily.
Xu Ziqi looked down at the happy little girl in front of him with a loving look on his face.
"You are a foodie! You don't care about life-saving things, but you are so concerned about a storage bag."
Lin Jiangyue put away the plastic bag and remembered that she was still cooking and watching the fire and rice.
"Okay, okay, it's not boiled."
Xu Ziqi saw Lin Jiangyue's sincerity and sighed that Zhang Dahu had accepted a good disciple. He left with a single word and left with satisfaction.
"Martial Nephew Lin, Master Zhao's formation is not terrible. Only by having the courage to face your heart can you explore all emptiness, and only by staying calm in times of danger can you break the formation."
Lin Jiangyue raised her eyebrows, flipping through the steamed rice, and whispered.
"If only it were so easy!"
After Lin Jiangyue steamed the rice, he immediately mixed the diced animal meat into the hot rice.
Taking advantage of the warm stickiness of the rice, add the washed chopped green vegetables and diced fresh mushrooms, stir well repeatedly, and knead into solid rice balls.
Then process the small fish caught from the stream, remove the scales and dirt, wipe off the water, deep-fry in hot oil until crispy, and then dip it into the prepared sauce while it is still hot to make a shiny and salty oil-soaked fish.
I wanted to find some more egg pancakes from Chuying Egg Stall, but I couldn’t find them near the cave.
I had no choice but to take out the remaining sun-dried chicken meat, steam it until soft, and let the steamed thick soup soak into the rice.
Then tear the chicken into thin shreds, add spicy seasoning, mix well, wrap it on the surface of the rice ball and knead it into a ball.
After an operation, Lin Jiangyue squinted tiredly and stretched.
Finally, she excitedly put the prepared ingredients into ziplock bags.
But of course she left out five of the shredded chicken rice-stuffed dishes she wanted to eat the most.
The tender and slightly spicy chicken paired with the salty rice will make you feel happy.
"It would be nice if I had a little wine at this time!"
Lin Jiangyue rolled her eyes and remembered the jar of wine Liu Xin had given her. She opened the lid and took a sip.
"Beautiful, beautiful."
After drinking spiritual wine, one's spiritual power will be full, and after eating spiritual food, one's physical strength will be full.
"It's so magnificent."
After eating the last one, Lin Jiangyue wanted to get it again, but when she saw her belly, she patted it lightly, causing ripples: "I can't eat any more, I'm going to turn into a little fat pig!"
After dinner, Lin Jiangyue put away the kitchen utensils on the stove and found the moon on the treetops.
I wanted to meditate and practice Qigong while I was full of energy.
